name: windowed denoising KV rewrite
claim: masked-diffusion-denoising applied to the KV cache so that a bounded trailing window of past key/value entries is iteratively refined by later context before being frozen.
new_capability: the model can correct or sharpen earlier key/value representations using information that arrived after they were written, instead of being stuck with whatever was computed at write-time.
placement: every k decode steps (k a hyperparameter, e.g. 16-64), take the last w KV entries per layer (w << context length), mask/noise a subset of their value vectors, and run 1-4 bidirectional denoising steps conditioned on the surrounding unmasked KV entries in that window only; a small denoiser (shared across layers or per-layer, few hundred K params) is trained jointly with the base model on the same LM objective, with a stop-gradient boundary so future reads use denoised entries but the denoising step itself never reads tokens past the current decode position beyond the fixed window (window is entirely in the past relative to the read that triggers it). Trained from scratch at matched budget alongside a matched-FLOPs vanilla baseline.
invariant: outputs stay causal; because the refreshed entries are always a function of tokens already emitted (the window lags the write head by at least one denoising cycle), no future token's content ever leaks backward into a prediction made before it existed.

Trained from scratch at matched FLOPs/params against a standard top-k MoE baseline (interaction matrix counted against the parameter budget).

name: Spectral KV cache compression
claim: Spectral-transform applied to the kv-cache so that stored entries are represented in a frequency basis (e.g. DCT over the time axis per feature) where long-range slowly-varying structure collapses onto a few low-frequency coefficients
new_capability: The cache can discard high-frequency (rapidly-changing, likely noise-like) components of old KV history while keeping low-frequency trends cheaply, giving a principled frequency-domain compression knob instead of arbitrary eviction.
placement: For each feature dimension of K/V, maintain a rolling block (e.g. 64 timesteps) and apply a DCT along the time axis per block once the block is fully committed; keep only the top-f frequency coefficients (learned or fixed threshold f), discard the rest, and reconstruct via inverse DCT at read time before attention. No new parameters needed for a fixed-basis version (DCT), or a small learned basis (like a Fourier-feature linear layer) trained jointly at matched FLOPs.
invariant: exactness is recoverable; the discarded high-frequency coefficients' total energy is logged, and if reconstruction error for a block exceeds a threshold the full block is retained losslessly, giving a verified approximation.

name: learned-index KV lookup

name: information-bottleneck KV pruning
